entities.name: David M. Moore
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: David Moresby Moore was a British botanist who wrote two reference works on Antarctic and sub-Antarctic flora, co-edited a book on Patagonian flora and wrote numerous other books on plant cytogenetics and global flora.
